TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
6241 North Rockwell Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 6241 North Rockwell Street from a RS-2 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District to RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District in order to
lawfully establish the existing second floor addition and construct a new rear deck and
wheelchair lift. The subject property is improved with a two-story single-family home with a rear
accessory two-car garage. The property was originally constructed as a one-and-a-half story
building but was improved with a 24 floor addition in 2016. The Applicant purchased the
property in 2023 and sought to expand the existing deck to the second floor and construct a
wheelchair lift. During the permit review process, their permit application was denied for a lack
of permitting history for the existing 2nd floor addition. The Applicant simply seeks to bring the
subject property into compliance with the zoning ordinance. The use will remain unchanged, and
no commercial space will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks an administration adjustment to reduce
the following rear yard open space standards: (1) to reduce the required minimum rear yard open
space from 267.33 square feet to 0 square feet under Section 17-13-1003-K; and a variation to
reduce the required rear setback from 34.9 feet to 30 feet under Section 17-13-1101-B.
